newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia gathers 42.4 mln tonnes of grain - agency.
newsitem.headline: Russia gathers 42.4 mln tonnes of grain - agency.

text.p: Russia has so far harvested and threshed 42.4 million tonnes of grain, up from 38.8 million in the same period last year, Interfax news agency quoted a Russian Agriculture Ministry official as saying on Tuesday.
Ivan Gridasov, head of the ministry's plant growing department, said crops had been harvested from a total of 25.1 million hectares, against 27.6 million ha in the same period last year.
The total area harvested so far accounts for 52 percent of the total area sown to grain.
Average crop yields have been 1.69 tonnes per hectare, 0.29 tonnes up on the same period last year.

Russia's Belgorod, Voronezh and Volgograd regions, as well as the republic of Kalmykia, have already harvested over 80 percent of the sown area, while progress in Tula, Tver, Smolensk and Ulyanovsk is lagging behind 1995.
